query:
SELECT release AS "release!", id AS "id!"
                FROM (
                    SELECT rt.release, g.id,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rt.release ORDER BY g.id) AS rn
                    FROM release_tag rt
                    JOIN tag t ON t.id = rt.tag
                    JOIN genre g ON g.name = t.name
                    WHERE rt.release = ANY($1)
                      AND ($2::int IS NULL OR g.id > $2)
                ) ranked
                WHERE rn <= $3
                ORDER BY release, id
